description: Use when you already know a topic and need only what changed since a date (your last run, a report date): which AI-engineering patterns and shifts got stronger or weaker, what became obsolete, forecasts that resolved (none yet while every forecast is still open), which new items are new facts versus new angles on known stories, and the Field Notes and analyses published, plus what still holds. With entity (a provider, tool or model from https://newruntime.com/timeline.json, e.g. anthropic): that entity's dated milestones since the date instead (releases, prices, deals, people, shutdowns; each with its source and quote; up to two years back). With as_of: the window ends then and known records show the confidence and stage of the weekly knowledge snapshot in force (https://newruntime.com/knowledge-snapshots.json), with nothing recorded later. Saves re-reading and re-deduplicating the web. Free, no auth. Examples: {"since": "2026-09-01", "topic": "mcp"}, {"entity": "anthropic", "since": "2026-10-01"}.

as_of.description: Optional ISO date or date-time: answer as New Runtime knew it then (a date alone = end of that day). Not with entity.

entity.description: Optional entity slug or name from /timeline.json: returns its milestones since the date (not with topic).

since.description: ISO date or date-time of your last known state, e.g. 2026-09-01. Default: 7 days ago; at most 90 days back.

topic.description: Optional topic slug or name (agents, coding-agents, MCP...) or a system (openclaw, hermes).
